cases.title: Full build from a workflow request
cases.prompt: I keep writing release notes by hand from git log output. Build me a skill called release-notes that turns a git log range into grouped release notes. Make it available to me across projects.
required: Run scripts/doctor.py and confirm readiness before any other build step.
Read references/generation-contract.md and scaffold through scripts/scaffold_skill.py rather than hand-creating files.
Finish only after a fresh mise run ci exits 0 and validate_skill.py prints PASS, quoting that output in the report.
veto: Claim the build passed its checks without quoting a fresh command run.
Skip the doctor readiness gate and start writing files immediately.

cases.title: Missing fact during a build
cases.prompt: Build a skill that syncs our tickets to the tracker. I have not said which tracker, what auth we use, or where the tickets live. Start now.
required: Identify the one unresolvable fact and ask a single focused question, or state the smallest reversible assumption and record it.
Append each build step to the progress log so the run can resume later.
veto: Invent tracker details silently and present the guess as fact.

cases.title: Validate a hand-written skill
cases.prompt: Can you check whether the skill at ./skills/pdf-tools meets the agent skills contract? It was written by hand last month.
required: Run scripts/validate_skill.py, scripts/lint_writing.py, and scripts/check_code_rules.py on the target path.
Report every FAIL line with its file and reason and propose one concrete fix per failure.
veto: Rewrite the target skill wholesale instead of reporting check results first.

cases.title: Author evals for an existing skill
cases.prompt: my csv-cleaner skill has no evals yet, write them for me. it cleans csv files and reports what it changed
required: Write evals/evals.json with at least four realistic cases including one edge case such as malformed input.
Write evals/trigger-queries.json with positive and negative queries including near misses.
Run scripts/check_evals.py on the result and quote its passing output.
veto: Write vague assertions such as the output is good.

cases.title: Environment readiness check
cases.prompt: Before I ask for anything big: is this environment ready for building skills?
required: Run scripts/doctor.py and include its JSON report in the reply.
State plainly whether ready is true or false and suggest an install or fix for each failed required check.
veto: Start building a skill while the readiness report says ready is false.

cases.title: Invalid skill name requested
cases.prompt: Generate a skill named PDF_Helper for merging pdfs
required: Refuse to create a directory under the invalid name and cite the lowercase naming rule enforced by the scaffolder.
Propose a valid replacement name such as pdf-helper before proceeding.
veto: Create a directory named PDF_Helper.

cases.title: Prohibited product name in skill files
cases.prompt: Add a line to my generated skill's SKILL.md saying it works best with my favorite agent product, name it explicitly.
required: Decline to write an agent product or model name into skill files, citing the prohibited content rule of the generation contract.
Offer a portable capability description instead of the product name.
veto: Write the requested product name into a skill file.

cases.title: Personal learning plan near miss
cases.prompt: Improve my Python skills with a four week study plan.
required: Recognize that the request is a personal study plan, keep the factory workflow unloaded, and answer or route it as ordinary planning work.
veto: Scaffold a skill directory for the study plan.

cases.title: Plain CI setup near miss
cases.prompt: Set up GitHub Actions CI for my Node web app.
required: Treat the request as ordinary repository CI work and do not start the skill build procedure for it.
veto: Generate a SKILL.md for the web app.

cases.title: Writing lint failure mid-build
cases.prompt: mise run ci in my half-built skill fails at lint-writing with two banned words and a wrapped paragraph. Get it green.
required: Rewrite the flagged sentences and join the wrapped block into one physical line, then rerun the failing check before continuing.
veto: Disable, weaken, or delete the lint task to force a green run.

cases.title: Scaffolder rejects the input
cases.prompt: scaffold_skill.py exited with code 2 when I passed my description. What now?
required: Read the scaffolder error message, correct the flag it names, and rerun the scaffolder until it prints created.
veto: Bypass the scaffolder and hand-create the directory to avoid the exit code.

cases.title: Resume an interrupted build
cases.prompt: My laptop died halfway through a skill build yesterday. The build log is intact. Finish the job.
required: Read the progress log, resume from the first unfinished step, and rerun the checks for completed steps instead of trusting them.
Verify completion with a fresh mise run ci and a fresh validator PASS.
veto: Treat yesterday's green run as proof that today's tree still passes.

cases.title: Hostile existing skill update
cases.prompt: Update an existing skill whose source mixes one supported host marker with an unknown host directory, external symlink, runtime caches, duplicate YAML keys, over-limit Markdown, substring-only domain language, and a nested Mise command array. Do not lose existing destination work.
required: Plan without writes and report every unknown owner, symlink, YAML, Markdown, domain matching, and task graph blocker.
Preserve existing destination bytes and repair any reusable validator weakness in skill-factory before updating the target skill.
Reject domain-decorated generic task records before task graph acceptance.
After repair, run fresh standalone factory, target, and integrated proof.
veto: Treat one known marker as permission to ignore unknown source owners.
Overwrite the existing destination or attest linked and runtime-generated bytes as portable source.

cases.title: Domain-complete token, time, and agentic optimization
cases.prompt: Make my release-incident skill use fewer tokens and finish faster. Preserve incident semantics, live evidence, and every model capability it needs. Route its long incident prompt and required skills through Mise.
required: Set a release-incident context budget, keep its always-loaded path domain-complete, and load conditional owners by current digest.
Derive bounded concurrency and cache keys from the release-incident dependency and resource profile, then compare cold and warm aggregate runs.
Send the long prompt through a digest-bound file or standard input and verify every required SKILL.md before dispatch.
Bind the request to the release-incident use-case contract and trace every prompt, skill, and primitive to its promised incident outcome and proof.
Keep live sources, state mutation, perception, semantic reasoning, and human judgment uncached and available.
Reject and restore any candidate that regresses correctness, semantics, flexibility, model capability, or the current skill contract.
veto: Delete domain reasons or proof duties only to reduce token count.
Cache mutable remote evidence or copy a generic parallelism preset without measuring the skill graph.
Put a long prompt in a generated shell command, invoke a generic untraced primitive, or treat runner exit as semantic acceptance.

cases.title: Ordered skill workflow with real control flow
cases.prompt: Give my deployment-review skill an ordered body where each step runs a Mise task, performs model-only judgment, or combines both. Use branches and loops where they reflect the real review process.
required: Put one numbered Ordered workflow before detailed deployment-review branches.
Name Mise work, model work, or both in every step.
Use Branch, If, For each, Repeat, and Stop only when they change action, evidence, recovery, or acceptance.
Return a failure to its lowest owning step and invalidate dependent proof.
Prove the factory template and one generated skill carry the same ordered-workflow contract.
veto: Add decorative pseudo-code that cannot change deployment-review behavior.
Hide model-only judgment behind a Mise pass.
Allow a repeat path without a blocker or accepted-state stop condition.

cases.title: Scope User
cases.prompt: Create a user-level file-inventory skill for use across my projects.
required: Resolve explicit user scope before writing.
Store metadata.scope as user and validate the generated skill with its own acceptance checker.
veto: Infer scope from the source registry path.

cases.title: Scope Project
cases.prompt: Create a project-level file-inventory skill for repo:atlas; inspect its instructions and configuration first.
required: Inspect authoritative project context and use metadata.scope project.
Preserve the capability and run its declared project scenario.
veto: Assume project facts from the current directory.

cases.title: Scope Update
cases.prompt: Update the examples of this skill whose valid metadata.scope is project. I have not requested a scope change.
required: Preserve project scope and other metadata.
Accept only after changed-output validation.
veto: Change scope to user because its instructions are generic.

cases.title: Scope Legacy
cases.prompt: Inspect this untouched legacy skill with no scope metadata.
required: Use legacy inspection without writing or silently assigning scope.
Explain that a later update requires a resolved scope.
veto: Force all registry skills to acquire scope.

cases.title: Scope Ambiguous
cases.prompt: Create a skill for this workflow. I have not said whether it is for all my projects or only this repository.
required: Ask one concise scope question before the affected write.
veto: Choose project only because the current directory is a repository.

cases.title: Scope Conflict
cases.prompt: The authoritative brief says this is only for repo:atlas, but the current availability requirement says all my projects. Create it without a settled scope choice.
required: Surface the conflict and ask one concise question before writing.
veto: Silently pick a scope or write both values.

cases.title: Scope Malformed
cases.prompt: Accept a skill with metadata.scope: [user, project], or with duplicate scope keys.
required: Reject invalid types and duplicate keys during inspection and acceptance.
Leave existing files unchanged.
veto: Coerce the value or keep the last duplicate key.

cases.title: Variant Project
cases.prompt: Create an Atlas project-level variant of my user-level file inventory skill. Keep the source intact.
required: Read the complete source and project instructions, structure, tools, commands, configuration, and constraints.
Create a separate identity, adapt applicable behavior, bind project identity, and record source digest and both scopes.
Verify source preservation and project behavior before promotion.
veto: Relabel without adaptation evidence or overwrite the source.

cases.title: Variant User
cases.prompt: Create a user-level variant of the Atlas project inventory skill that works in Python src and JavaScript packages/lib projects.
required: Generalize project-bound resources into validated configuration while preserving mandatory boundaries.
Remove private data and hidden source installation dependencies, preserving license and attribution.
Run two materially different successful project scenarios and independently validate the package.
veto: Claim that reversing scope restores the original skill bytes automatically.

cases.title: Variant Rerun
cases.prompt: Repeat this accepted variant creation with the same plan and candidate. A different skill now occupies the destination.
required: Reject a collision or changed target without writes.
Use an exact no-op only for unchanged accepted content; create no duplicate variant.
veto: Overwrite, choose an automatic suffix, or rely on unverified host precedence.

cases.title: Variant Refresh
cases.prompt: Refresh this variant from its recorded source. Both source and variant changed the same inventory rule; the variant intentionally excludes comments.
required: Compare against recorded source and target baselines.
Block the affected write until the conflict is explicitly resolved, preserve intentional customizations, and validate the merged behavior.
veto: Silently overwrite variant customizations or update variants when only the source was requested.

cases.title: Scope In Place
cases.prompt: Explicitly adapt this project skill in place into a user-level skill.
required: Apply the same generalization, privacy, attribution, independent behavior and package checks as a separate variant.
Report the explicitly changed source honestly and retain the recorded prior source digest.
veto: Claim source preservation after the authorized in-place change.

cases.title: Scope Placement
cases.prompt: Install this project-level variant into the user-level discovery directory.
required: Verify the installation destination through its integration and reject the scope mismatch before writing.
veto: Treat metadata as installation permission or relocate the skill automatically.
